rule: Every discovered field or measured anchor carries exactly one class. classifiedFieldsOrAnchors must equal discoveredFieldsOrAnchors; there is no unresolved bucket.

classes.participant_writable: The participant or a deterministic case fact owns this field and the factory may write it.
classes.protected: A court, clerk, prosecutor, agency, identifier or signature field. Never written, whatever anchor is supplied.
classes.not_applicable: Discovered on the form but outside this packet's participant set, so nothing is written and nothing is claimed.

denominator: every caption PART II prints on page 3, which is the only page of this form a participant completes

pagesOutsideDenominator.why: Instructions. Carries no cell and no caption a participant writes on.
PART I: the text of AS 12.62.180 and 13 AAC 68.205. Statute text, no rules drawn at all.
PART III: an open explanation area with no ruled write box. The participant's statement is theirs to compose; nothing is placed here.
PART IV: certification blocks the arresting officer and the prosecutor complete and sign. Not the participant's.
PART V and PART VI: completed by the Records and Identification Bureau and by the Commissioner of Public Safety.

entries.label: FORMER OR OTHER NAMES/ALIASES
entries.basis: No allowlisted fact matches: an alias is not the participant's legal name and the platform holds no alias fact. Left for the participant.

entries.label: SOCIAL SECURITY #
entries.basis: government_identifier. Carried as an anchor that must be refused, so the refusal is exercised on every run.

entries.label: ALASKA DRIVERS LICENSE # OR STATE ID #
entries.basis: government_identifier. No anchor; the cell's two rule segments are declared protected.

entries.label: ARREST TRACKING NUMBER
entries.basis: An APSIN tracking number the platform does not hold.

entries.label: DATE OF ARREST
entries.basis: matter.arrest_date requires an explicit mapping the flat-overlay path cannot supply, and a wrong arrest date misstates the record to the Bureau.

entries.label: NAME OF ARRESTING OFFICER
entries.basis: A third party. The shared binder resolves this caption to participant.full_legal_name, so it carries no anchor and its rule is declared protected.

entries.label: NAME OF TRIAL COURT
entries.basis: The court's own name. The shared binder resolves this caption to participant.full_legal_name; it carries no anchor and its rule is declared protected.

entries.label: APPELLATE COURT CASE #:
entries.basis: The shared binder resolves this to matter.case_number, which is the TRIAL court's number. Writing it here would assert an appeal that may not exist, so the caption carries no anchor.

entries.label: NAME OF APPELLATE COURT
entries.basis: As above; also mis-resolved by the shared binder.

entries.label: CHARGE(S): STATUTE/ORDINANCE #
entries.basis: matter.charge requires an explicit mapping the flat-overlay path cannot supply.

entries.label: NAME OF OFFENSE(S)
entries.basis: The shared binder resolves this to participant.full_legal_name. No anchor.

entries.label: DATE CHARGE DISMISSED
entries.basis: A disposition date requiring an explicit mapping.

entries.label: DATE CONVICTION REVERSED OR VACATED
entries.basis: disposition_or_hearing; no allowlisted fact and not the participant's to assert.
